verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that connects a user's AI assistant to the platform. Through it the assistant can understand the customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage and create syncs, generate ad creatives, and analyze performance in plain language. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: documented connection setup details (transport, authentication flow, supported clients), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
